name: product-builders-pack
description: Claude for Product Builders: 32 Claude skills for taking one idea from a question to a prototype real users can try, and on to a build, change or stop decision, in eight stages: frame it with a problem frame, an idea one-pager and a prototype test card with a dated pass line; spec it with a prototype brief, a screen-by-screen user flow and a prototype spec; build a clickable prototype in Claude Design; make one flow really work in Claude Code; check it is safe to show with a secrets and keys check, a personal data check, an access and sharing check and a pre-share sign-off; test it with five real target users; hand it to engineering with everything faked written down; then get a decision from a named person. For product managers and product designers who want to build a prototype themselves, and founders shaping a first product. Claude builds the prototype, real users test it and engineers own what ships.
